fact: Zambia's National Crop Monitor was launched at a Lusaka workshop in 2024, where teams from all 10 provinces, including Ministry of Agriculture and Zambia Meteorological Department staff, compared their 2023/24 season assessments with satellite data (MODIS, VIIRS, CHIRPS, Landsat, Sentinel-2).
title: Zambia launches national Crop Monitor to enhance agricultural resilience amidst drought crisis
